name: task
description: Run an agent topology on a request. Default: PlanThenImplement + Dual consensus per phase. Use --agent-config to switch topology (preset name, .yaml file path, inline JSON, or registered alias).

parameters.name: --confirm
parameters.description: Plan, wait for user approval, then implement (PTI only). Uses PTI's enable_checkpoint_plan_review.

parameters.name: --agent-config
parameters.description: Topology spec: preset name (pti/pti-simple/bta/bta-dual/dual/single/multi-flow/multi-flow-dual), file path (.yaml), inline JSON, or registered alias (BTA/Dual/MultiFlow/MultiFlowDual). PTI is preset-only — no _target_ alias.

parameters.name: --model
parameters.description: Override every model_name leaf in the cfg.

parameters.name: --no-dual
parameters.description: Collapse Dual nodes to base_inferencer (cheap mode).

parameters.name: --max-iterations
parameters.description: Cap on iterations when --multi-iter is set.

parameters.name: --resume
parameters.description: Resume from an existing workspace directory (PTI uses native resume_workspace field).

parameters.name: --initial-plan
parameters.description: Load plan from file, skip planner phase. Implies --execute. Uses PTI native initial_plan_file field.

examples: /task --agent-config bta --model sonnet "list 3 ways to learn python"
returns: Topology execution result with workspace_path + plan_path/impl_path artifacts.
